message.content: The primary fluence agrees with the analytic value to 0.1%, and the scattered fluence per Φ0 is 0.393. Next I'll add event recording for the depth-dose estimate. Each interaction within 3 cm of the axis needs its electron energy and direction stored.
message.reasoning:
Checking the primary transmission: 0.6086 observed versus 0.6094 predicted analytically using total attenuation coefficient at 2 MeV, within 0.1% agreement. Now I'm looking at the scattered fluence ratio, which comes out to 0.393.

That gives a scatter-to-primary ratio of 0.645 and a scattered fraction of about 39% of total fluence, both plausible for this geometry at 2 MeV, 10×10 field at 10cm depth. To improve statistics I should run more histories, maybe splitting 2×10^7 across 4 parallel processes to keep runtime manageable. I also realize I haven't implemented event recording for interactions anywhere along the central axis (r<3cm) needed for the PDD calculation—I only tracked events at the scoring plane. I need to add recording of Compton, photoelectric, and pair production interaction positions and electron energies/directions whenever they occur within r<3cm, not just at the detector.

Adding event-recording logic to track electron kinematics for PDD computation...
